Build a Reproducible Apptainer/Singularity .def Recipe

Source: R/apptainer.R
build_apptainer_def.Rd

Generates an HPC-ready Apptainer (formerly Singularity) container definition file from a scan_project_env() manifest (or project directory path). Automatically includes minimal Debian/Ubuntu system libraries for detected compiled toolchains (Rcpp, cmdstanr, RTMB, TMB, JAGS, sf, etc.), thread-safe BLAS/OpenMP defaults, renv::restore() or pinned CRAN installs, optional CmdStan installation, and container smoke tests (%test).

Usage

build_apptainer_def(
  env,
  base_image = NULL,
  r_version = NULL,
  output_path = NULL,
  install_cmdstan = NULL,
  cmdstan_version = "2.35.0",
  renv_restore = NULL,
  cran_repo = "https://packagemanager.posit.co/cran/__linux__/jammy/latest",
  image_name = "slurmpilot_env.sif",
  labels = list(),
  extra_apt = character(),
  extra_post = character()
)

Arguments

env

A slurmpilot_env object from scan_project_env(), or a path to a project directory to scan automatically.

base_image

Optional Docker base image (defaults to "rocker/r-ver:<r_version>").

r_version

Optional R version string overriding env$r_version.

output_path

Optional file path to write the .def recipe to disk.

install_cmdstan

Optional logical controlling whether to build CmdStan inside /opt/cmdstan. Defaults to "cmdstan" %in% env$toolchains.

cmdstan_version

Character CmdStan version when install_cmdstan is TRUE. Default "2.35.0".

renv_restore

Optional logical; if TRUE, copies renv.lock via %files and runs renv::restore(). Defaults to env$has_renv_lock.

cran_repo

CRAN/Posit Package Manager repository URL used inside %post.

image_name

Target .sif filename used in the suggested build command. Default "slurmpilot_env.sif".

labels

Optional named list of extra %labels entries.

extra_apt

Optional character vector of extra Debian/Ubuntu apt packages.

extra_post

Optional character vector of extra shell lines appended to %post before apt cache cleanup.

Value

An S3 object of class "slurmpilot_apptainer_def" containing recipe (character vector of lines), text (single string), path, base_image, image_name, build_command, and env.

See also

scan_project_env(), render_sbatch_script()

Examples

env <- scan_project_env(extra_packages = c("lme4", "Rcpp", "RTMB"))
def <- build_apptainer_def(env)
cat(def$text)
#> Bootstrap: docker
#> From: rocker/r-ver:4.6.2
#> 
#> %labels
#>     GeneratedBy slurmpilot
#>     RVersion 4.6.2
#>     Toolchains cpp,tmb,linear_algebra
#>     EnvHash a58a0203d04b
#> 
#> %environment
#>     export LC_ALL=C.UTF-8
#>     export LANG=C.UTF-8
#>     export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
#>     export OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
#>     export MKL_NUM_THREADS=1
#>     export R_REMOTES_NO_ERRORS_FROM_WARNINGS=true
#> 
#> %post
#>     set -eu
#>     export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
#>     apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
#>         build-essential \
#>         ca-certificates \
#>         cmake \
#>         g++ \
#>         gfortran \
#>         liblapack-dev \
#>         libnlopt-dev \
#>         libopenblas-dev \
#>         make
#> 
#>     mkdir -p /root/.R
#>     cat <<'EOF' > /root/.R/Makevars
#> CXX17 = g++
#> CXX17FLAGS = -O3 -fPIC
#> CXX17STD = -std=c++17
#> EOF
#> 
#>     Rscript -e "install.packages(c('RTMB', 'Rcpp', 'lme4'), repos = 'https://packagemanager.posit.co/cran/__linux__/jammy/latest', Ncpus = max(1L, parallel::detectCores() - 1L))"
#> 
#>     apt-get clean
#>     rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
#> 
#> %test
#>     Rscript -e "cat('R:', R.version.string, '\n')"
#>     Rscript -e "stopifnot(all(vapply(c('RTMB', 'Rcpp', 'lme4'), requireNamespace, logical(1L), quietly = TRUE)))"
#> 
#> %runscript
#>     exec Rscript "$@"
